rundown: Midshipmen beat 49ers 28-26 at Jerry Richardson Stadium in Charlotte, NC. Midshipmen came back: they were down 17-14 at the half. The 3rd quarter decided it: Midshipmen won it 7-0.

Scoring: Midshipmen 4 touchdowns and 0 field goals; 49ers 3 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: C. Harrell pass to D. Eley for 44 yds, for a TD (Two-Point Conversion failed) (4th quarter, 0:56).

Leading the way — Midshipmen: Jackson Gutierrez 7/11, 90 yds, 1 TD, 33 car, 166 yds, 3 TD; Charles Robinson 3 rec, 52 yds. 49ers: Conner Harrell 21/27, 335 yds, 2 TD; D'Mariun Perteet 7 car, 24 yds, 1 TD; Derrick Eley 8 rec, 199 yds, 2 TD.
Where Midshipmen won it: they held the ball 36:13 to 23:47.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Midshipmen closed as 16.5-point favorites and won but didn't cover (49ers +16.5 cashed); the total closed at 51.5 and they combined for 54, over by 2.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 28, 11:57 AM ET. It had Midshipmen 85% and 49ers 15%, projecting Midshipmen 32.8 – 49ers 16.9 (49.8 total, Midshipmen by 15.9).

Final: Midshipmen 28 – 49ers 26. Right winner: it had Midshipmen at 85%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Midshipmen came in with a 3% below average attack and a 6% leakier than average defense (4-6, 30.1 scored and 30.8 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 187 and 187 games of evidence. Projected to score 32.8, they scored 28 (−4.8 points, 15% under); projected to allow 16.9, they allowed 26 (+9.1 points, 53% over).

49ers came in with a 36% below average attack and a 35% leakier than average defense (1-10, 18.8 scored and 36.7 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 193 and 194 games of evidence. Projected to score 16.9, they scored 26 (+9.1 points, 53% over); projected to allow 32.8, they allowed 28 (−4.8 points, 15% under).

The bigger miss was 49ers' scoring (+9.1 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 54 against 49.8 projected (+4.2), about the 61st percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±15.5).

Margin: Midshipmen by 2 against Midshipmen by 15.9 projected, about the 82nd percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±15.3).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 64% of bets on Midshipmen, 55% of the money — 49ers covered; total: 58% of bets on the over, 30% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 96% of bets on Midshipmen, 91% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Midshipmen, who won and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.020 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +13.4 points. It counts toward CFB scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 217 graded CFB games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.5 points. Team corrections so far: Midshipmen attack ×1.040, defense ×1.040 (3 games); 49ers attack ×0.994, defense ×0.964 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
